image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small brown rabbit (cottontail) sitting in green grass. The rabbit is facing left, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. Sunlight illuminates the fur, highlighting texture. The background consists of out-of-focus green foliage.

The definition between the lower jawline and the chest fur is somewhat indistinct. The anatomy feels slightly 'mushy' or lacking in skeletal rigidity compared to a high-resolution photograph.
